facts.text: The Australian Street Stock Championship is a Dirt track racing championship held annually to determine the Australian national champion.
facts.source_quote: The Australian Street Stock Championship is a Dirt track racing championship held each year to determine the Australian national champion.

facts.text: Dirt track racing is a type of auto racing performed on clay or dirt surfaced oval tracks.
